A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable versions of the same work. All 13 pages were compared, including the four results tables, Algorithm 1, and the proofs in Appendix A. No material gaps limit comparison.

before.justification: v1.pdf reports original molecular-generation experiments in Section 4, including G-VFM results on QM9 and GEOM-Drugs and property-controlled generation results in Table 4.

after.justification: v2.pdf retains the original experiments and outcomes in Section 4 and Tables 1–4, including unconditional and property-controlled molecular generation.

M1.justification: The controlled VFM objective, Bayesian fixed-point inference procedure, and equivariant formulation are unchanged. Algorithm 1 is retitled from 'Bubble Sort' to 'Sampling Controlled VFM', but its inputs and procedural steps remain identical.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same discrete, continuous, and joint molecular-generation tasks on QM9, ZINC250k, and GEOM-Drugs, with the same six QM9 property-control targets. The added introductory mention of molecular-generation research introduces no evaluated coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every corresponding table. For example, Table 4 retains EDM, EQUIFM, GEOLDM, and D-Flow. The newly cited Guzmán-Cordero et al. work is not added as an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Section 4 and the table captions retain identical evaluation settings, architectures, metrics, and sampling information, including MAE over 10K samples in Table 4. No experimental protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: No ablation, robustness test, sensitivity analysis, or case study is added or removed. The brief Section 4.1 finding about stability dropping without equivariance remains unchanged, and Appendix A contains the same proofs.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates without repeated-run counts, random-seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 1–4 and the accompanying findings are unchanged. Examples include G-VFM's QM9 NLL of -120.7 in Table 2 and polarizability MAEs of 2.05, 2.25, and 1.98 for its three variants in Table 4.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, objectives, derivations, and Propositions 3.1–3.2 are unchanged. Appendix A.1–A.2 retains identical proposition statements and proofs, including Equations 19–24.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets, and conclusion retain the same claims about controlled generation, Bayesian post-hoc control, equivariance, and molecular-generation performance. The introductory citation addition does not redefine these contributions.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same proof-of-concept qualification for Bayesian inference, performance-versus-computation discussion concerning D-Flow, architectural qualifications, and future directions. No substantive interpretation or limitation is added or revised.

D1.justification: Architecture references, classifier-training information, sampling pseudocode, and implementation disclosures remain unchanged. The corrected algorithm title supplies no new technical settings or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: v2 adds Guzmán-Cordero et al. (2025), 'Exponential family variational flow matching for tabular data generation', to the introduction and bibliography, alongside an added mention of molecular-generation tasks. This is a limited expansion of prior-work acknowledgment; Section 5 is unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds a short phrase and citation to the introductory VFM paragraph and corrects Algorithm 1's unrelated 'Bubble Sort' title. The section organization and remaining prose are unchanged apart from text reflow and the version stamp.

P2.justification: Algorithm 1's caption changes, and the introductory addition and new reference cause limited text reflow across the opening and bibliography pages. Tables 1–4 retain identical content, formatting, and placement; the appendix layout is unchanged.

improvement.justification: Changing Algorithm 1's title from 'Bubble Sort' to 'Sampling Controlled VFM' removes a misleading label and improves clarity. The additional introductory citation modestly expands context. These are limited editorial gains; the methods, experimental evidence, and appendix proofs remain unchanged.
